name: anthropic-claude-opus-5-5
auth: Claude Code subscription login (keychain OAuth), or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; honors ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (e.g. the apex-router proxy at :8788). Do not add --bare: it ignores keychain auth.

name: openai-gpt-5.6-sol
auth: Codex CLI ChatGPT/Codex login (`codex login`, ~/.codex/auth.json), or OPENAI_API_KEY; no proxy needed.

name: moonshot-kimi-k3
auth: MOONSHOT_API_KEY, else the key pi stores for provider moonshotai (`pi auth print-api-key --provider moonshotai`). Calls MOONSHOT_BASE_URL (default https://api.moonshot.ai/v1) directly: the apex-router proxy forwards /v1 to api.openai.com, so routing Kimi through :8788 returns 401.

name: local-ornith-35b
auth: No credential. Local ollama at OLLAMA_HOST_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:11434); native /api/chat so num_ctx can be raised above ollama's default context. Zero-cost fourth opinion; not a separate vendor for independence purposes.
